summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT) with hands-on experience building, testing, and evaluating artificial intelligence tools across robotics, computer vision, and language model systems. Skilled at comparing model and tool tradeoffs through direct benchmarking, translating technical findings into practical recommendations, and documenting workflows for cross-functional teams. Background spans automation of both physical and data-driven processes, from manufacturing workcell simulation to real-time data dashboards.

experience.title: General Secretary
bullets: Led a 25-member robotics team across national-level competitions, owning mechanical design, PCB fabrication, and AI/ML integration end-to-end.
Organized 10+ exhibitions and technical workshops covering Arduino, PCB design, and SolidWorks.

experience.title: Python Developer Intern
bullets: Developed a Python GUI using PyQt and Matplotlib for real-time data acquisition and dashboard-style visualization in a laboratory environment.
Used GitLab for version control and JupyterHub for collaborative data analysis and technical documentation.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Fine-tuned DONUT (OCR-free visual document understanding transformer) on a custom medical billing dataset for structured field extraction.
Built preprocessing and training pipelines in PyTorch using the HuggingFace VisionEncoderDecoder API.
Improved validation accuracy from 55% to 93% via improved preprocessing and model tuning.

experience.title: Research Fellowship
bullets: Led a cross-cultural team of 7 as the sole ML-experienced student; took over as team lead mid-project to restructure task distribution and deliver the full pipeline within a 6-week window.
Trained U-Net segmentation with VGG-16/19 and ResNet-50 backbones; reported accuracy-latency tradeoffs for deployment.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) - MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Resolved 11 integration failures across the automation pipeline; achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end voice-to-picked latency.
Integrated faster-whisper speech-to-text, Gemini prompt-based intent classification, and TensorRT-optimized YOLO (5.2x speedup) across a distributed edge pipeline.

projects.name: SLM Compression and Benchmarking for Edge Deployment
bullets: Reduced GPU memory footprint by ~55% via 8-bit quantization (bitsandbytes LLM.int8()) on TinyLlama 1.1B; profiled peak VRAM and inference latency across prompt types using pynvml and psutil.
Benchmarked across HellaSwag, GSM8K, and ARC; under 1% accuracy degradation, near-lossless compression.

projects.name: ABB RobotStudio Automation Simulation
bullets: Validated full-cycle repeatability of an ABB RobotStudio workcell built for an end-to-end press-to-packing assembly pipeline with CAD-modeled fixtures.
Programmed in RAPID with TCP socket-based pose acquisition and interrupt-driven press-bench logic.
